# rd_vu_flat0_ab, rd_vu_flat0_gl (test/rd_vu_flat0_ab.cmake) and
# rd_vu_compact_ab (test/rd_vu_compact_ab.cmake): a fixture, the profiles it
# is replayed under (corpus, mali, pixel: the scripts' heads say what each
# is; OpenGL replays every fixture at the corpus settings alone), then the
# properties the two tests check (rd_fixture_list_props.cmake), each holding
# on every =1 run compared:
#   prepass_vertices    rd_vu_flat0_ab: the mesh and grid vertices the
#                       record holds, drawn by the provoking corner's shader
#   vu_compact_left_out rd_vu_compact_ab: list 0's triangles the compaction
#                       left out
#   region_rule_draws   rd_vu_compact_ab: the VU draws the camera rule
#                       decided (0 on a frame dumped before the facing
#                       tables: the PS2's drops kept)
# The counts each pair of rd_vu_compact_ab prints are lists/vu_compact_counts.txt.
#
# a Mac reporter's 16:9 frame (version 11, no facing tables)
fx-gate-102 corpus prepass_vertices>=1 vu_compact_left_out>=1 region_rule_draws=0
# issue 179's Mali-G52 (moto g24 power, v0.11.5): the manual frame (stage 3)
# and a slow-scene capture (stage 42)
fx-mali-frame mali,corpus prepass_vertices>=1 vu_compact_left_out>=1 region_rule_draws>=1
fx-mali-slow541 mali,corpus prepass_vertices>=1 vu_compact_left_out>=1 region_rule_draws>=1

fx-opening-sun pixel prepass_vertices>=1 vu_compact_left_out>=1 region_rule_draws>=1
